chitchat: pats the launch rail and squints up into the haze.
"Fly over Redline, you pay the Redline toll. One way or another."
description: A Redline gang missileer draped in red, one hand resting on the SAM nest's launch rail like it's a pet. He grins at the sky the way a man grins at easy money.

bye.text: They turn back to the guns and the sky.

root.text: They keep one eye on the sky. "Unless you're here to help work the guns, you're in the way. Move."

name: a Redline missileer
